what: Plan adds tracking as a second bootstrap phase instead of replacing the existing infra bootstrap call
scenario_or_breakage: The existing SKILL block already runs --up-to-phase infra; the proposed tracking block would run phase_infra again, likely allocating a second IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env before adoption and leaving downstream prompt variables tied to the first run
suggested_fix: Update the existing Step 0 bootstrap invocation to a single --up-to-phase tracking call that parses infra plus tracking KVs, or add an explicit reuse/skip-infra mode before keeping two calls

what: ISSUE_NUMBER tail fallback repopulates the upstream issue in fork mode
scenario_or_breakage: With --forked-target true --issue-number 42, phase_tracking leaves ISSUE_NUMBER_RESOLVED empty but emit_final_tail falls back to ISSUE_NUMBER_OPT, contradicting the fork contract and allowing later PR/comment paths to treat #42 as a local tracking issue
suggested_fix: Special-case forked-target-skip so ISSUE_NUMBER emits empty, and carry the upstream issue in a separate variable such as UPSTREAM_DESIGN_ISSUE

what: Branch 1 resume logic does not validate the sentinel contract before returning
scenario_or_breakage: A malformed or unusable parent-issue.md with FAILED=true, ADOPTED empty/false, missing ISSUE_NUMBER, or missing RUN_ID can be classified as branch-1-resume, skip Branch 2, and continue with empty tracking state
suggested_fix: Treat any nonzero/FAILED=true, ADOPTED!=true, or missing ISSUE_NUMBER/RUN_ID as unusable; remove or quarantine the sentinel and fall through to Branch 2, with a harness case

what: The proposed RUN_ID fallback is not shared with the sentinel writer
scenario_or_breakage: If session-id is empty but LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID is populated, phase_tracking can initialize larch-log with that RUN_ID, then post-tracking-issue.sh fails because it only reads parent-issue.md or session-id, leaving initialized logs without metadata/sentinel
suggested_fix: Update post-tracking-issue.sh to use the same LARCH_TOKEN_SESSION_ID fallback or require phase_tracking to repair session-id through the sanctioned writer before calling it
